_comment: EMPTY, and that is the point: every source the image clones is now a vibeic
fork. Owner ruling 2026-07-29: fork everything we actually use.
The six that were pending here (kissat, cadical, ASAP7_for_KLayout,
asap7_pdk_r1p7, asap7sc7p5t_28, OpenROAD-flow-scripts) were blocked by
GitHub's fork API returning 403 'You cannot fork this repository at this
time'. That block is on the FORK endpoint only — creating a repo in the org
and pushing refs into it works, and the rate limit was 4988/5000 at the time,
so it was never budget. They were mirrored that way instead.
One is a SUBSET, and that is recorded rather than hidden:
asap7sc7p5t_28 carries only CDL/LVS, the subtree the image sparse-checks-out.
Its full history is 2.8 GB and the push fails HTTP 500 on large files. A
change there cannot go upstream as a normal PR until it is re-forked
properly — see that repo's README.
check_fork_only reads this file. An entry here is a NAMED, DATED exception,
never a silent allowlist, and an expired one FAILS the build.
2026-07-31: the last entry (trilinos/Trilinos) is CLOSED, and its stated
reason turned out to be wrong. It said the mirror route was not a drop-in
because at 853 MB this is the size range where the content API fails on
large files. clone+push does not use the content API. The push succeeded
from a 1.8 GB working tree; GitHub emitted a large-file WARNING for one
55 MB .mat file and took the push. tools/xyce/Dockerfile now clones
vibeic/Trilinos. Nothing is pending: check_fork_only reports 49 of 49
references ours, 0 pending, for the first time.
